verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud hosting platform, so automatic compute placement is a fair question to ask of it. The only related evidence is the claim 'Run your application closer to where your users are.' That is about placing apps near users, not automatically placing compute near backend data to optimize latency. No evidence shows automatic data-proximity placement.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
